messages.silentRun: [warn] {count} step(s) with no progress entry{target}. Next: start or update the tree.
messages.staleProgress: [warn] {count} step(s) without a progress change{target}. Next: update detail/progress or close it.
messages.staleEscalation: [block] progress reminder #{n}: tree unchanged after {count} steps{target}. Update or close it now.
messages.relayPattern: Repeating long command ({count}×): {pattern}. Next time wrap it: progress-relay --id <id> -- {command} (or pipe it).
messages.idle: [block] turn ending with {count} stale/error own task(s): {targets}{excluded}. Close or continue.
messages.wall: [warn] no progress for {age}{target}. Next: update detail/progress or close it; wrap long commands in the relay.
messages.sayLongTool: That {tool} call ran {seconds}s with no narration this turn. Before the next long-running step, post a say with what it is doing and a rough ETA.
messages.saySilentRun: That was tool call {count} in a row this turn with no say note. Before the next step, post a say with what you are doing and a rough ETA.
